summary: gyomu-schema provides canonical data schemas and models for the Gyomu system, specializing in Python AST and code structure analysis, structured document validation and translation, and domain-specific knowledge representation.
responsibilities: Define canonical schemas and data models for Python code structures, AST analysis, and type representation.
Provide validation rules, translation instructions, and structured models for documents and sections.
Define domain-specific error handling and recovery strategy models.
Offer shared utility functions for serialization, timing, results wrapping, and filesystem operations.

capabilities.name: Python AST and Type Models
capabilities.description: Defines schema models, union types, and kinds for representing Python AST expressions, statements, and type structures to support analysis.

capabilities.name: Python Code Structure Analysis
capabilities.description: Provides data models and schemas for Python code structures, symbols, modules, files, project configuration, and dependencies.

capabilities.name: Structured Document Schemas
capabilities.description: Defines data models, validation rules, translation strategies, and content elements for structured documents and sections.

capabilities.name: Error Handling Models
capabilities.description: Provides core error handling models, domain-specific error classes, and resolution strategies for AI, configuration, database, and validation.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Management Schemas
capabilities.description: Defines schemas for structuring knowledge domains including coding guidelines, technical documentation, operational knowledge, and roadmaps.

design_decisions: Leverages Pydantic base models and type adapters for robust data serialization, validation, and JSON schema conversion.
Uses union types and discriminated models to accurately represent complex Python AST nodes, statement kinds, and document content elements.
Provides modularized domain-specific schemas covering code analysis, documents, errors, and knowledge bases.
usage_guidance: Use the provided Pydantic models to validate, serialize, and deserialize Python analysis results and document structures.
Leverage utility functions for JSON and YAML validation, execution timing, and result handling.
